delivery: User authorized commit and main merge; no release or personal installation replacement.

actual_acceptance.failure_meaning: Paused or unresolved goals fail acceptance; this does not mean nine program crashes.
actual_acceptance.pending_meaning: Queued/running or stale-audit acceptance remains NOT_RUN.

limits: The original 24 real-use goals are not all complete; this is not all-family release certification.
Actual Claude subscription authentication and live schema response are unconfirmed.
Legacy semantic verification still inspects retained history and can remain slow or unresolved.
Lossless model readback is paged; one page does not represent the complete original.
Collection has no arbitrary byte/row ceilings, but memory usage still grows with in-memory rows/checkpoints.
No external message, form submission, purchase or personal installation replacement is part of this merge.
